want.who_she_is: Twenty-four, broke, eight months without a word from her sister Dana (29), who worked the season at the Linden and stopped answering in May. She signed Dana's old hostess contract to find out why.
want.obligation: Dana left owing the club; Julian puts it on her as 'Dana's tab', $300 every Sunday, counted at his desk. It never runs out. Missed: off the floor and shut out of upstairs for the week; the game does not end.
want.appetite: To be the one the whole room asks for by name, and to know everything the men at the Linden know.
want.ascent: From trays on the bar floor and every door upstairs shut, to the run of the members' floor, the library after hours, Julian's office and the boats at the docks; booked by name.

why_this_person.julian: The man who made Dana; being wanted by him is being told she is better. Visibly wants her as Dana.
why_this_person.ade: The one man here who looks at her. Visibly wants her and is scared of it; pours her drink before she asks.
why_this_person.kessler: Old money, filthy, honest about it; holds page one. Visibly wants her reading aloud to him, standing.
why_this_person.noor: One step ahead of her; companion and rival for Dana's old place.
